title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18
lineage: FLAC -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Dolby B) -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard mix brings out the high‑energy Boston Garden show, highlighted by a smoking second set and standout “Samson & Delilah” and encore “It’s All Over Now, Baby Blue”.
ai_review.review: The upgraded Charlie Miller SBD provides clear, punchy audio that captures the crowd’s excitement.  Reviewers rave about the solid first set and an especially high‑energy second set, while noting a few minor flubs (e.g., in “Truckin’”).  Overall the performance shines despite a few mixed comments.

ai_rating.rationale: Three strong 5‑star reviews and one 4‑star review praise both the musical performance and the crisp soundboard recording, while a few low‑star comments are unrelated or focus on minor issues, leading to an overall positive but slightly moderated rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix; captures crowd energy well; no reported drop‑outs or major balance problems. Reviewers note the SBD upgrade as a significant improvement over previous audience recordings.

standout_songs: It's All Over Now, Baby Blue
show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid first set followed by a high‑energy second set; the band feeds off the enthusiastic Boston Garden crowd and maintains strong momentum through the encore.

band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for a powerful ‘Phil bomb’ at the start of “Samson & Delilah”.
